facts.value: Refreshes only CmSubject.bone_pos through the configured camera joint and co_attrs.x170 local offset. If the selected joint is null, the helper copies the local offset directly. The wrapper does not rebuild pos, extents, facing, state or ledge flag.
facts.rationale: Narrow inherited camera-bone-derived wording to account for the directly observed null-joint fallback.

evidence.why: Initialization copies calculated pos into bone_pos.
Update writes distinct fields and delegates bone_pos.
Configured joint and local offset passed to transform helper.
Null joint copies raw local offset; joint branches transform it.
